### A. Data (B1). New tables and ADD COLUMN only; no referenced table is rebuilt
**0061 (drizzle):**
1. **`webhook_events`:** `id` (uuidv7), `provider`, `event_id` (≤ 64), `event_type`, `received_at`, `status` (received/processed/ignored/needs_review/failed, held by trigger), `attempts` INT DEFAULT 0, `processed_at`, `outcome` (code), `facts` JSON as a **whitelist only** (link ID, payment ID, amount, currency, method, `account_id`; **no raw payload, email, phone, VPA or card data**, L8). UNIQUE `(provider, event_id)`; partial `(received_at, id) WHERE status='received'`.
2. **`checkout_sessions`** (generic for M6.3/M6.4): `id` (uuidv7; Razorpay's `reference_id`), `provider`, `document_id` → documents, `client_id` → clients, `contact_id` → contacts NULL, `doc_token_id` NULL, `created_by` → staff_users NULL, `source` (portal/link/staff), `currency`, `amount_minor` CHECK > 0, `status` (creating/live/paid/expired/cancelled/stale/failed, by trigger), `provider_link_id`, `short_url` (≤ 200), `expires_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `last_refresh_at`, `paid_payment_id` → payments NULL. UNIQUE partial `(document_id) WHERE status IN ('creating','live')`; UNIQUE partial `(provider, provider_link_id) WHERE provider_link_id IS NOT NULL`; `(client_id, created_at)`.
3. **`review_items`** ("Needs review"): `id`, `source` (webhook/dlq/refresh), `provider`, `kind`, `status` (open/resolved), `webhook_event_id`, `payment_id`, `document_id`, `client_id` (all NULL-able), `amount_minor`, `currency`, `facts` JSON (whitelist), `created_at`, `resolved_by`, `resolved_at`, `resolution` (confirmed/advance_issued/left_as_credit/dismissed), `note` ≤ 500. Partial `(created_at, id) WHERE status='open'`; UNIQUE partial `(webhook_event_id, kind)`; `(payment_id)`.
4. **`hook_failures`:** `(key PK, window_start, count)`.
5. **`payments` ADD COLUMN:** `provider_payment_id`, `checkout_id` → checkout_sessions, `fee_tax_minor`, `refetched_at`, `webhook_event_id`; UNIQUE partial `payments_provider_ref (provider, provider_payment_id) WHERE provider_payment_id IS NOT NULL`. `charges_minor` holds Razorpay's `fee`, absorbed (M6.1 L9); `fee_tax_minor` its `tax`. **Check the meaning of `fee` and `tax` against Razorpay's payment-entity docs** (unverified).

**0062 (`gateway_triggers`, `scripts/write-triggers.ts`):**
- `payments_values_*`: `provider IN ('manual','razorpay')`; `mode` adds card, netbanking, wallet, emi, paylater, other.

### B. Core (B1; pure; ≥ 90 % coverage; new money modules in `no-floats.test.ts`)
- **`packages/core/src/payments.ts`:** `CheckoutRequest.paymentId` → `checkoutId`, plus `description`, `expiresAt`, `callbackUrl`; `ProviderEventType` adds `checkout.paid`, `checkout.partially_paid`, `checkout.expired`, `checkout.cancelled`; `ProviderEvent` gains `checkoutRef`, `paymentRef`; `PaymentStatusReport` gains `method`, `feeMinor`, `feeTaxMinor`, `createdAt`, `orderRef`; new methods `fetchCheckout(ref)`, `cancelCheckout(ref)`; `checkProviderContract` extended.
- **`packages/core/src/razorpay.ts`** (subpath `@techaust/core/razorpay`; no `fetch`):
  - `verifyRazorpaySignature(rawBody, sigHex, secrets[])`: HMAC-SHA256 through `crypto.subtle.verify` (constant time); hex-decode first, anything not 64 hex characters fails; current secret, then the previous one.
  - `parseRazorpayEvent(obj)` → `ProviderEvent | invalid_event` (safe integer amounts > 0).
  - `linkRequestOf({checkoutId, amountMinor, documentNumber, documentId, expiresAt, callbackUrl})`: `accept_partial:false`, `notify:{sms:false,email:false}`, `reminder_enable:false`, no `customer`; `reference_id` = checkoutId; `notes:{document_id, checkout_id}`; `description` "Invoice {number}"; `expire_by` now + 7 days in seconds (≥ 15 minutes, ≤ 6 months); amount ≥ 100 paise.
  - `readRazorpayLink`, `readRazorpayPayment`, `judgeRazorpayPayment(checkout, link, payment)` → ok or `not_captured`, `amount_mismatch`, `currency_mismatch`, `reference_mismatch`, `order_mismatch`, `payment_not_on_link`, `partial_payment`; `methodToMode`; `keyModeOf(keyId)`; `razorpayAllowed(keyId, settingsMode, liveFlag)` (a live key needs settings mode live **and** `liveModeAllowed("live", flag)`; a test key needs mode test).
- **`packages/core/src/online-pay.ts`:** `payAmountVerdict({amountMinor, balanceMinor, floorMinor, wholeRupees})` → ok or `amount_below_minimum` (`minimumMinor = min(floor, balance)`), `amount_above_balance`, `amount_not_whole_rupee`; `payableOnline(doc, client)` → ok or `not_payable_online` with a reason. Payable: `tax_invoice`, `debit_note`, `proforma`; INR; a **domestic** client (Q3); frozen; not void or withdrawn; balance > 0. A proforma always needs whole rupees (`target_not_whole_unit`, LD28).
- **`@techaust/core/gateway-rpc`:** `GatewayEventsApi` (`processRazorpayEvent`, `issueGatewayAdvance`), `PortalPaymentsApi` (`createLink`, `refreshForClient`), with runtime answer guards (the `care-billing` pattern).
- **Queue kinds:** `gateway.event {eventId}`, `gateway.advance {paymentId}`, `gateway.sweep {asOf}`, `isGatewayKind`.
- **`permissions.ts`** + docs/04 §9: `payments.link` {owner, staff: allow}; `payments.review` {owner: allow}; the review list uses `payments.read`.
- **`packages/db`** (statements only): `recordGatewayPaymentStatements` (confirmed and allocated; pending with `requested_allocations`; overpayment remainder left as credit), `checkoutStatements`, `reviewItemStatement` (INSERT OR IGNORE), `GATEWAY_AUTO_SQL` authority plus an `authority` option on `advanceIssueStatements` (splitting `issuedBy`, NULL for gateway_auto, from `receiptCreatedBy`; `advance_receipts.created_by` is NOT NULL → the active Owner who issued the proforma), `gatewayDeadLetterStatements`.

### C. Admin finance Worker (B2)
**RPC entrypoints in `apps/admin/worker/finance.ts`** (exactly the listed public methods; every ID argument 1–64 characters; one ID-only log line each):
- **`GatewayEvents`** (bound by jobs as `ADMIN_GATEWAY`). `processRazorpayEvent({eventId})` → `{result: processed|ignored|needs_review|duplicate|retry, next?}`:
  1. Event not `received` → `duplicate`.
  2. `payment_link.expired` / `.cancelled`: move the checkout (guarded); event processed.
  3. `payment_link.paid` / `.partially_paid`: find the checkout by `provider_link_id`; none → review `unknown_link`, no payment row.
  4. **Re-fetch** `GET /v1/payment_links/{id}` and `GET /v1/payments/{id}` (Basic auth, `AbortSignal.timeout(8000)`, the live guard before any fetch): network error or 5xx → `retry`; 404 → review `refetch_failed`.
  5. `judgeRazorpayPayment`.
  6. Tax invoice or debit note, ok, still payable: **one batch** — INSERT payment `rzp_<payment id>` (confirmed, provider razorpay, `received_on` = IST day of the payment's `created_at` (L11), `mode` from the method, `reference_norm` = the normalised payment ID, charges and fee tax, `refetched_at`); allocate `min(amount, balance)` by INSERT…SELECT; recompute; `ledger_result`; checkout → paid; other open checkouts of the document → stale; event → processed; audit (actor `webhook`); owners' bells. Excess stays as client credit (ADM-PAY-06) with an `overpaid` review item for information. After the batch, cancel stale links through the API (best effort, logged).
  7. Proforma, ok, amount ≤ proforma balance: one batch — payment `pending_verification` with `requested_allocations=[{proforma, amount}]`; checkout → paid; event → processed; audit; bells; answer `next: {kind:"gateway.advance", paymentId}`. Above the balance → review `proforma_overpaid`, no automatic issue.
  8. Mismatch, not payable, or anonymised: client known and not anonymised → payment `pending_verification` (no ledger move) + a review item of the matching kind; anonymised → review `client_gone` only.
  `issueGatewayAdvance({paymentId})` → `issued | already_issued | blocked | not_pending`: the `invoice-advance.ts` steps with authority `gateway_auto`, no `confirmInrExport`/`route` (overseas excluded). `GATEWAY_AUTO_SQL` in the freeze `WHERE`: the pending razorpay payment, re-fetched, of exactly this amount; its checkout `paid` for this proforma; the proforma's `issued_by` an active Owner; client not overseas; INR; `SIGNED_FREEZE_SQL`; every M5.1 settings, client and contact guard. Issuer "system" with the trade name (`care-billing.ts:597` pattern); new invoice `issued_by` NULL; audit actor `system`, summary `{authority:"gateway_auto", onBehalfOf}`. Success: PDF through the queue, and the email to billing contacts with portal and finance access the way automatic care invoices go (Q44, the 09:00–19:00 IST window, Q48; L17). Any blocker → review `advance_blocked` with the codes + bell; the payment stays pending and the Owner uses **"Confirm by issuing the tax invoice"** (`POST /invoices/:id/advance-invoice` with `paymentId`, reference prefilled with the Razorpay payment ID).
- **`PortalPayments`** (bound by the portal as `ADMIN_PAY`). `createLink({clientId, contactId|null, tokenHash|null, documentId, amountMinor, returnTo})`: re-check in SQL (contact live, portal access, can see finance, belongs to the client — or the doc token live, bound, unrevoked; document belongs to the client; `payableOnline`; `payAmountVerdict` with floor `payment_terms.razorpayMinPartialInrMinor`). An open link for the same amount expiring more than 1 h ahead is **reused**; a different amount cancels the old one through the API first. **Row first:** INSERT a `creating` checkout (the unique index serialises two clicks; the loser gets 409 `link_in_progress`), create at Razorpay, then `live`. "Reference already attempted" → `GET /v1/payment_links?reference_id=` and adopt. 10 links per client per hour, else 429 `too_many_links`. Audit actor `contact`. Answer `{shortUrl, expiresAt, reused}`. `refreshForClient({clientId, documentId})`: re-fetch an open link at most once per 60 s (`last_refresh_at` in the `WHERE`), same processing as a webhook with source `refresh` (ADR 0008 allows a status fetch).
- **Routes** (`routes-finance.ts`, `X(...)`, `on: "finance"`):

  | Route | Action | Audit |
  |---|---|---|
  | `POST /invoices/:id/payment-link` `{amountMinor, expectedUpdatedAt}` | `payments.link` | `payment.link_create` |
  | `POST /invoices/:id/payment-link/cancel` `{checkoutId}` | `payments.link` | `payment.link_cancel` |
  | `POST /payments/links/:id/refresh` | `payments.link` | |
  | `GET /payments/review` (keyset ≤ 50; status/kind) | `payments.read` | |
  | `POST /payments/review/:id/resolve` `{resolution, note}` | `payments.review` | `payment.review_resolve` |
  | `POST /payments/review/:id/retry` | `payments.review` | `payment.review_retry` |
  | `GET /payments/gateways` (keys present on **finance's** env, mode, last verified webhook) | existing gateway-settings read | |
  | `GET /invoices/:id/payments` gains gateway rows and the open link | unchanged | |
- **Changes:** `POST /payments/:id/verify` `rejected` on a razorpay row → 409 `gateway_refund_needed`; withdraw on a razorpay row → 409 `gateway_payment`. The admin API's `settings.ts` (`gatewayStatus(env)`, line ~255) stops claiming gateway status (L15); `GATEWAY_SECRETS` split per Worker; `settings.test.ts:520` updated.
- **Razorpay client:** `apps/admin/worker/gateway/razorpay.ts` implements `PaymentProvider`; only `api.razorpay.com`; confirm the cancel path `POST /v1/payment_links/{id}/cancel` against Razorpay's docs; passes `checkProviderContract` with a stubbed `fetch`.
- **Errors:** 400 `amount_below_minimum` (`minimumMinor`), `amount_above_balance` (`balanceMinor`), `amount_not_whole_rupee`; 409 `not_payable_online` (`reason`), `link_in_progress`, `link_not_live`, `review_resolved`; 429 `too_many_links`; 503 `gateway_unavailable`, `live_not_allowed`; 502 `gateway_error`; `stale_version`, `client_gone`.
- **≤ 45 D1 statements per RPC invocation** (processing ≈ 15, advance ≈ 37), pinned by a counting test.

### D. Jobs Worker (B2)
- **`apps/jobs/src/hooks/razorpay.ts`, `POST /razorpay` only** (other methods or `/razorpay/*` → 404, no D1). In order: JSON content type else 415; streamed 64 KiB cap else 413; secret unset → 503 `hook_unconfigured`, nothing written; signature missing or malformed → 400 `signature_missing`, **not counted**; `verifyRazorpaySignature` over the **raw text**, failure → 400 `signature_invalid` + `UPDATE hook_failures SET count=count+1 … WHERE count < 50`, one owners' bell at 5 (INSERT OR IGNORE); parse; event ID = `x-razorpay-event-id` (≤ 64, `[A-Za-z0-9_]`) else `sha256:` of the body + a log line (**the header isn't signed**: real idempotency is `rzp_<id>` + the unique `provider_payment_id`); unknown event type → row `ignored`, 200; `INSERT … ON CONFLICT(provider,event_id) DO NOTHING`, read status; new or still `received` → `LEADS_QUEUE.send({kind:"gateway.event", eventId})`; 200 `{ok:true}`; a queue failure → 500 with the row kept. Never log the body, signature or secret. **Hook CPU ≤ 5 ms p99** (JOB-HOOK-03).
- **`queue.ts`:** `gateway.*` kinds route **before the lead fall-through** on the `-leads` queue (reuse `LEADS_QUEUE`, no new hosted queue, L9). `gateway.event` → `adminGateway(env).processRazorpayEvent`; `retry` → `message.retry` with backoff; `next` enqueues `gateway.advance`. The DLQ writes `gatewayDeadLetterStatements` (event failed + review `dead_letter` + bell).
- **`apps/jobs/src/gateway-rpc.ts`:** the `billing-rpc.ts` pattern.
- **Hourly tick:** one `gateway.sweep` in the existing `sendBatch`; the consumer re-enqueues up to 20 `received` events older than 15 minutes with `attempts < 10`.

### E. Portal (B2)
- `POST /api/v1/invoices/:id/pay {amountMinor}` (`finance` row in `guard.ts`, CSRF, `forClient`) and `POST /api/v1/t/document/pay {token, amountMinor}` (token only in the body; doc-token read; failures count toward `p:fail:`). Both call `ADMIN_PAY.createLink`; `shortUrl` host must be `rzp.io` or `razorpay.com`, else 502.
- `callback_url`: signed in `{PORTAL_URL}invoices/{id}?pay=return`; token or staff links `{PORTAL_URL}pay/return` (static, no token in any URL). The SPA strips the query at once (`history.replaceState`) and never forwards Razorpay's parameters.
- `invoice-summary.ts`: `payOnline` flags and an `online` block (`open {amountMinor, expiresAt} | null`, `lastPaid {amountMinor, at} | null`, `proformaPending`), every query bound to the client. `GET …/invoices/:id?refresh=1` may call `refreshForClient` after 20 s of Processing.

### H. Tests (failure paths included)
- **Core:** signature (valid, wrong secret, one body byte changed, re-serialised JSON fails, non-hex, wrong length, empty, upper-case hex, previous secret accepted, never a string compare); parse (four link events, unknown → `other`, unsafe amounts → `invalid_event`); judge (ok + every verdict); `linkRequestOf` bounds (100 paise, ≥ 15 min, ≤ 6 months, reference ≤ 40, notes ≤ 15 × 255, no customer, notify false); `payAmountVerdict` (fast-check); `payableOnline` per reason (overseas refused); key guard (`rzp_live_` with flag false refused; test key with mode live refused); `methodToMode`; permissions; contract helper; no-floats.
- **db:** 0061 CREATE/ADD COLUMN only; 0062 regenerates byte for byte; manual-payment triggers unchanged; razorpay rows (gateway columns required, reject/withdraw refused, gateway_auto flip, unique `provider_payment_id`); two concurrent `creating` checkouts → one; every status flow; no deletes; overpayment remainder → credit with `ledger_result` holding; `GATEWAY_AUTO_SQL` refuses an inactive issuer, a payment not pending, a different amount, no signature, an overseas client, settings changed; EXPLAIN on new indexes.
- **Jobs:** valid → 200, one row, one message; **duplicate delivery** → 200, no second message; duplicate while `received` → re-enqueued; **replay with a new event-ID header** → still one payment row (end to end with finance); bad signature → 400 counted, 5th → one bell, cap 50 → no write; missing signature → 400 not counted; 415, 413 (streamed), GET 404, `/razorpay/x` 404; queue failure → 500 with the row; secret unset → 503 no D1; logs carry no body or signature; routing before the lead fall-through; bad RPC answer → retry; `next` → advance; DLQ → failed + review + bell; sweep ≤ 20.
- **Finance:** recorded `payment_link.paid` → confirmed payment, allocation, invoice paid; duplicate → one row; **amount mismatch → pending + review, balance unchanged**; currency, reference, order mismatches; unknown link → review, no payment; not captured / 5xx → retry; 404 → review; voided invoice or withdrawn proforma meanwhile → pending + review; anonymised → review only; overpayment → credit + review; partial event → review; expired and cancelled; reminders stop after payment. Proforma: pending → advance → `TH/INV/…` with parent, paid, proforma converted, receipt `created_by` = proforma issuer, `issued_by` NULL, audit `system`; two parallel advances → one invoice; a blocker → review with the payment pending, then the Owner's "Confirm by issuing" with `paymentId`. `createLink`: contact without finance → 404; another client → 404; token path (valid, revoked, expired); below minimum, above balance, paise on a proforma; USD, overseas, export, void, withdrawn or paid → 409; reuse; new amount cancels the old (stub records it); two parallel requests → one create; create error → failed + 502; reference-already-attempted adopts; live key → 503 with **zero fetch calls**; 10/hour → 429. Routes per role (Owner and Staff make links; Sales and Accountant 403; only the Owner resolves). Settings status from finance. 45-statement count; erase ≤ 45 with review notes cleared.
- **Portal:** CSRF; cross-client 404; token only in the body; host allow-list; RPC missing → 503 (C14); summary flags.
- **Split and config:** `check-worker-config`, worker-budget (metafile), `split.test.ts`, `staging-health`.

### I. Free plan and bytes
One unit of work per message (event, advance, sweep); cron only enqueues; a webhook costs 1 send, 1 consumer run, 1 RPC (a proforma one more). Hook: HMAC over ≤ 64 KiB, one parse, 2 D1 statements, 1 send (≤ 5 ms p99). Each RPC metered on its own (≤ 7 ms; staging cold reading). Bytes (estimates): jobs ≈ 680,000 of 1,000,000; finance ≈ 545,000 (plan line 650,000); portal ≈ 110,000 of 120,000 (watch); admin API and front about the same.

### J. Done means
#138 merged in and the B1 remainder of Step 0 done; B1 and B2 committed and both early checks GO; the CPU diagnosis applied; `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm db:generate` (no diff) green; bytes and startup recorded for all five Workers; screenshots in this file; reviewer approves, re-check passes; 07-ZI placed word for word; H1–H3 done before auto-merge; after deploy, one sandbox payment on staging confirms through the webhook on an invoice and one on a proforma that issues its tax invoice (mind the 30-link test-mode cap); every tax or legal comment carries its 08-C tag.

### K. Out of scope
M6.5: receipts (TH/RCT), refunds (and so reject/withdraw of gateway payments), settlement and fee reconciliation, GST on the fee and ITC, the ₹25 lakh warning, the general live-key guard. M6.3/M6.4: Stripe, PayPal. M7.1: the method chooser, "I've paid", USD Pay. Never in M6.2: Razorpay UPI links (live only), Razorpay's own notifications, payments-register CSV columns, a legal hold.

### Tax and legal rules relied on
- RA-17 "Researched 2026-10-28" (GST on an advance due on receipt; a tax invoice for the amount received is valid; a proforma isn't a tax document; signature always required, rt2). OPEN (RA-17): whether that invoice fully meets s.31(3)(d) so no separate receipt voucher is needed.
- RA-12 "Researched 2026-10-28": place of supply from the client's current state at the payment's time of supply; `proformaSupplyChanged` blocks the automatic issue → review.
- RA-36 "Settled by the lead on the safest reading, 2026-10-31": an overpayment held as credit is an advance; the warning shows when it's used.
- RA-29 "Researched 2026-10-28": UPI MDR; the fee is absorbed, never billed to the client. OPEN (RA-29): GST on the fee invoiced to our GSTIN?
- RB-07 "Researched 2026-10-28": no card data stored; refunds to the original method (M6.5).
- RB-39 "Researched 2026-10-29": the ₹10,000 floor is a commercial setting; links have partial payments off.
- RB-01 OPEN: cross-border aggregator receipts as "settled in INR" (why Q3 A).
- **New, to add to 08-C (lead):** the receipt date of a gateway advance (s.13(2) explanation: the earlier of book entry and bank credit); built on the safest reading `received_on` = IST day of the payment's `created_at` (earlier than settlement); s.13 text to be read. And DPDP: no gateway payload row in 08-C; safest reading built — no payer email, phone, VPA or card fields stored (L8).

### Lead decisions (for 13 at integration)
L1 keys on finance only, webhook secret on jobs only, portal → finance by RPC · L2 fixed-amount link, `accept_partial:false`, the client picks a part amount in the portal · L3 `reference_id` = checkout ID, invoice ID in `notes` (Razorpay needs a unique reference per link; departs from ADM-PAY-02's wording) · L4 one open link per document; a new amount cancels the old; a stale link that gets paid becomes credit · L5 verified re-fetched gateway payments confirm without an Owner step (PRD) · L6 automatic advance invoice in its own message, authority the proforma's issuing Owner, any block leaves the payment pending · L7 mismatches recorded pending when the client is known + review; no reject/withdraw of gateway payments before M6.5 · L8 whitelisted facts only · L9 reuse `LEADS_QUEUE` · L10 no Razorpay customer object or notifications · L11 `received_on` = IST day of `created_at` · L12 domestic INR clients only (owner Q3 A) · L13 portal Pay now (Razorpay only) in M6.2; M7.1 keeps the chooser, "I've paid", USD · L14 signature-failure counter capped at 50/hour, alert at 5 · L15 gateway status read from finance · L16 local stub and `pay-simulate` · L17 the automatic advance invoice is emailed like automatic care invoices.

### Risks and not verified
The 30-link test-mode cap (tests never call Razorpay; the staging demo reuses links); Access path matching for `razorpay`; Razorpay reaching `workers.dev`; `secrets.required` ordering (held PR); portal byte headroom (~10 KB); the meaning of `fee`/`tax`; `max_concurrency 1` on the leads queue (seconds of delay behind lead work); the Workers Logs remap on staging; the Razorpay cancel path; `options.checkout.method` (undocumented, so any method is accepted and recorded); cross-app service bindings in local dev (tests stub them).

**Rules:** each agent its own branch from `origin/feat/m6.2-razorpay` (e.g. `feat/m6.2-b1`), push only that; commit at each finished layer and at least every 20 minutes; heavy commands through `bash tools/heavy.sh --log <name> <command>`; never touch hosted services (H1–H3 are the owner's); stop every dev server you started; append your report below.
